root_idea.summary: The root centers on dividing a thing into portions: each portion of a whole is a بعض.
root_idea.development: The central idea develops into the noun بَعْض for a part or some member of a whole, the causative بَعَّضَ for dividing into portions, and the inchoative تَبَعَّضَ for becoming divided. بَعُوضَة is treated lexically as a secondary formation associated with the small size of the mosquito.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized nominal citation form بَعْض; its case, suffix, and preposition variants are grammatical realizations of the same form.
Displayed under the singular noun citation form بَعُوضَة.

senses.definition: A part or portion of a whole; some member or members of a group, person, or thing.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in partitive and relational constructions such as “some of them,” “some of you,” and “some to or with another.” The portion may be small or large, even the greater part. In certain Quranic expressions, mentioning a part can pragmatically indicate the consequence or representative scope of a larger matter; this does not make “all” its ordinary lexical meaning.
The Quranic form is the singular noun; بعوض is used as its plural or collective form in the lexical evidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To bite, annoy, or molest by biting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used specifically of mosquitoes or gnats.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To divide something into distinct parts or portions; to separate or dismember it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction can describe dividing property or an object, including dismembering an animal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To have mosquitoes, or an abundance of mosquitoes, in a place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived Form IV verb describing a place in which mosquitoes are plentiful.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become divided into parts or portions.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An inchoative Form V construction describing division into separate parts.
Used adjectivally of a land or a night in which mosquitoes are numerous.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An impossible or extraordinarily difficult thing to obtain or undertake.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative idiom, as in imposing on someone the task of obtaining the “marrow of a mosquito.”

cautions: A reported interpretation of بعض in a Quranic construction as “all” is disputed; the supported ordinary sense is “a part” or “some,” with any wider implication treated as contextual or rhetorical.
A historical lexical citation using Roman-numeral notation is not converted here into an additional modern Quran location.
